Another day another circular another change, I am expecting big repurcations because of this...

Another NSE circular on retail algo trading, with possible implications for third-party platforms.

Static IPs are now only for retail clients who code their own algos.

These

This was there already but hardly any algo platform providers followed it, they continued to provide static ip to their users, now they will be in trouble if they continued to do it and brokers who support it will also be in trouble. 

India is really one of the toughest place to run a business related to capital markets. Very tight regulations.

Most importantly all these regulations delivering more and more problems to retailers

Their losses have never been minimized 

These brain less regulators only create problems by frequent policy changes as they are least bothered about its implications
Algo test is hit or not in this circular.?
Tbh this doesn’t necessarily sounds like a bad move
